name: SIDDAVATAM VISHNAVI
title: AI Engineer
tagline: Building AI-powered solutions and intelligent applications.
bio:
I'm a Computer Science and Engineering graduate with an interest in Full Stack Development and AI Engineering.

I have hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI, React.js, MySQL, and REST APIs. During my Full Stack Development training at Ojasa Mirai, I worked on connecting frontend, backend, and database components to build practical web applications.

I have also worked on AI-based projects, including an AI speech-based screening system and an AI Wellness Coach. I enjoy learning new technologies and building practical applications that solve real-world problems.
